Founding AI/ML Engineer
San Francisco, California, United States
Apply for this job
Founding AI/ML Engineer

Job Overview
Experience: 3+ years
Equity: Meaningful founding-level equity stake

Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable backend services and distributed systems.
Develop data processing and retrieval pipelines for large volumes of unstructured and structured data.
Integrate and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and other machine learning capabilities into production applications.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and other retrieval architectures for complex evidence datasets.
Develop solutions for structured data retrieval, including query planning, semantic modeling, and structured reasoning.
Build reliable data flows and integrations across AI models, backend services, and infrastructure.
Deploy, monitor, and optimize production systems in security-sensitive environments.
Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, and infrastructure approaches to improve platform capabilities.
Take ownership of technical decisions, from initial design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements.
Collaborate closely with the founding team to define architecture, product direction, and engineering priorities.

Required Qualifications
1. Backend Engineering and Distributed Systems
Strong backend software engineering experience, particularly building production-grade applications.
Ability to design resilient, secure, and scalable distributed systems.
Strong programming skills, especially in Python.
Experience working with cloud infrastructure providers, backend services, and production deployments.
Ability to own technical solutions end to end.
2. Applied AI/ML Engineering
Hands-on experience deploying LLMs, VLMs, or other machine learning models in real-world applications.
Understanding of integrating AI models into backend systems and production workflows.
Experience building AI-powered applications beyond prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
Ability to evaluate and adopt new models, tools, and AI architectures as the technology evolves.
3. Retrieval and Data Engineering
Experience designing RAG pipelines or comparable retrieval systems for unstructured data.
Ability to work with structured datasets and develop effective retrieval and reasoning mechanisms.
Understanding of data processing, indexing, search, and retrieval architectures.
4. Ownership and Startup Mindset
Demonstrated bias toward action and strong end-to-end ownership.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, early-stage startup.
Comfort working through ambiguity and making technical decisions with incomplete information.
Strong curiosity and willingness to experiment with emerging technologies.
5. Mission Alignment
Genuine interest in applying technology to public safety and law enforcement.
Motivation to build reliable, secure systems that support sensitive investigative workflows.
Commitment to high engineering standards and meaningful real-world impact.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building agentic AI systems that can reason, plan, and take actions across data sources.
Experience working with multimodal AI, including video, audio, and text processing.
Experience with AI-driven search, evidence analysis, or other complex information retrieval applications.
Experience developing secure systems for government, public-sector, or other sensitive environments.
Previous experience at an early-stage startup or as an early engineering hire.

Technical Skills and Technologies
Technical area
Relevant skills
Backend development
Python, backend architecture, API development
AI/ML
LLMs, VLMs, applied machine learning
Retrieval systems
RAG, information retrieval, semantic search
Structured data
Query planning, semantic modeling, structured reasoning
AI agents
Agentic workflows, reasoning and tool use
Infrastructure
Cloud platforms, distributed systems, production deployment
Data processing
Large-scale video, audio, text, and structured datasets
Security and reliability
Secure architecture, resilient systems, production monitoring

Note: React is mentioned in the original description, but its specific importance is unclear. The role emphasizes backend engineering and AI integration rather than frontend development.
